svg.aria-label: Diagram of four machines and 15 GPUs on 1 GbE. Every hop goes through the hub, GPURIG, which runs the llama.cpp server. A token visits, in order: 1, the Z13 tablet's Radeon 8060S (Strix Halo, 96 GB assigned, ROCm), blocks 0 to 19, 89.3 GiB, 41 percent of 218.0 GiB; 2, the rig's 11 cards of 8 GB on x1 risers, 7 NVIDIA on CUDA and 4 AMD on Vulkan, blocks 20 to 31, 61.2 GiB, 28 percent; 3, gamingrig's RTX 2080 Ti 11 GB and 4090 24 GB (CUDA), blocks 32 to 36, 25.5 GiB, 12 percent; 4, GPURIG's RTX A6000 48 GB (CUDA), blocks 37 to 44 and the output head, 42.0 GiB, 19 percent. The draft head is left out: it adds 3.3 GiB to the A6000 and 1.8 GiB to an RX 6600. The file, 223.8 GiB, also holds the draft head and 0.6 GiB kept in GPURIG's RAM.
